snippet.title: the docrot
snippet.description:
What's good my people, its your boy thedocrot and here's a little bit about what I'm doing here!

I'm trying to be consistent in uploading two shorts a day, every day, and two videos a week, one on Wednesday and one on Friday unless I say otherwise! I've kept this going for a while but I'll try and let you all know if I can't do it. 

Streams will start between 6PM-7PM UK TIME (EVERY DAY!!!) unless I say otherwise!

There will be exceptions to this as I have different things happening at different times every week but I will update you for those changes! 


Apart from that I'm here to bring good vibes and positive energy to your day so I hope you all enjoy!

Love and Peace my people! ❤️😁


Link to my Instagram (the docrot):
https://www.instagram.com/thedocrot?igsh=MW1rMTYwOHR0bnVuYw==

Link to my Tiktok (thedocrot):
https://www.tiktok.com/@thedocrot?_t=ZN-8zjEyZ7EROw&_r=1


I hope you all enjoy my videos and Don't forget to check out my clan LyNx!
Have fun people!

snippet.description:
What is good my people, it's your boy thedocrot and this time we are back with a WWE2K26 video!

This time it is a fight on my faction which took me FOREVER to win! 

As you will be able to tell the quality isn't great as it was clipped from a stream but it felt like a moment that was worthy of its own video!

Let me know if you want to see more WWE2K26 content, I have been trying to stream it once a week recently but if you would like to see any other content on it then comment down below!

For now though it has been your boy thedocrot, I hope you have an amazing day or an amazing evening and I shall see you all in the next one!

Love and Peace my people!

snippet.description:

This time it is a fight on my faction which took me FOREVER to win! 

As you will be able to tell the quality isn't great as it was clipped from a stream but it felt like a moment that was worthy of its own video!

For now though it has been your boy thedocrot, I hope you have an amazing day or an amazing evening and I shall see you all in the next one!

Love and Peace my people!
